name: omniauth/otp
description: Omniauth's one-time passwords over spomky-labs/otphp, under any PHP host - authenticator applications (TOTP; HOTP possible): the second factor, its enrolment (a secret and its otpauth:// address) and its revocation, with scheb/2fa's parameters (SHA1, 30 s, 6 digits, the same leeway and provisioning address) so the secrets an application keeps today go on working, a code accepted once only, and the secrets sealed at rest with libsodium (SodiumSecretBox, the key in the host's vault; the ones kept in clear read until rewritten). Formerly omniauth/totp, which it replaces (the Omniauth\Totp\ names stay aliases for one release).
